description: This file defines the `Notify` class, which models the `<notify>` element in an XML configuration for the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access the notify type and content, and includes constructor logic to parse these from an XML element.

classes.name: Notify
classes.description: A class representing a notify element in the service configuration, encapsulating its type and content.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Notify object by parsing the provided XML element, extracting the 'type' attribute and content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the notify element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type attribute of the notify element.
